item.title: [7.5] India bonds slump as oil spike adds to RBI hike bets
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds experienced a decline this week, largely influenced by rising oil prices and US Treasury yields. Analysts are anticipating a potential increase in interest rates from the Reserve Bank of India in their upcoming policy decision.

WHY IT MATTERS

item.title: [6.1] Boundary-Aware Policy Learning for Agent-Orchestrated Robot Manipulation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Agent-orchestrated robot systems combine the general reasoning capability of multimodal agents with the precise physical control of learned visuomotor policies. Yet such systems often fail at the moment of handoff: a policy is reliable only from a limited set of start states, while the agent may invoke it outside this region. We call this region the policy's handoff boundary.
